text: ok how about this, can I have an agent look at the sessions, and then i make some edits myself to a mesh, and then have the agent view it again, and then basically have them continue to do what i was doing for me. here let me show u example what i mean if u see this torso model all the quads that are long here are me coming over the triangle soup that i got out of model generation from tripo, and im cleaning it up while reducing the total poly, and it is insanely mechanical and boring as hell [Image #1]
resolution: Evaluated demonstration-driven retopology against the current Agent Seat and native mesh surfaces. The seat can inspect before/after percepts and action counts, while native tris-to-quads already provides candidate pairing and dry-run preview, but current action events and element snapshots do not expose exact local topology patches, face loops, adjacency, or a learnable before/after edit trace. Proposed a record-example topology-diff layer, flow-aware candidate scoring, protected boundaries, preview/step application, and explicit separation between authored quad grouping and genuine render-triangle reduction. No code changed in this design pass.
